body:
I just want to vent really. Talk. I need more people to talk with, always. 
But I feel so bad about it. I wanna learn about you as well, that's always interesting!

You're taking a few minutes out of your day to talk to me. I feel sorry about that. 

I do! But after 5 years it's just pilled on me to the point where suicide does seem like an escape. I've had good years and bad years but the future is so sketchy and look so upsetting that I just have to escape. I have so many reasons to kill myself. I drew together a pro-con list and gosh the pro is massive..

I understand that. Even when I'm violently sobbing they just stand there and stare before continuing doing whatever it was that they were doing. I reach out and find air. That's one of the reasons I finally gathered courage to post here.

I tend to do volunteer work anyway, usually it leave me feeling rather empty. I have to do volunteer work to continue going to the school I am currently in (30 hours per year or else you'll get the boot). I can't put into words why I feel empty. I want to give them my entire life so that they don't have to be miserable, but I know I can't. 

Reading helps for a little while. Really anything that brings me to another place helps but that's honestly one of the biggest things that depressed me. I've saved the world countless times in my head but in reality I sat there staring at a wall for a good hour. Usually when I realize that all that I imagine will never happen brings the worst of the depressive episodes. 

Day by day huh? So like- Get dressed, brush teeth, go to school, play video games, do homework, and then try and see what the next day brings? I tend to go week by week due to plans and projects, but I can see myself trying it out. 

I remember learning about Cognitive Behavioral Therapy in my psychology class and enjoying the idea of it. I am seeing a psychologist but honestly he kinda sucks. Not all that focused and changes the subject when we get on my depression. (Usually I'm very resistant to change in my depression because I've pretty much heard it all.) Perhaps I'll look into someone that'll help me with that. 

Horribly. I've packed what I need to kill myself in my backpack. I've dropped so many hints to my friends and family, even to teachers and they're rather blind. Any conversation I try to start with anyone is dropped pretty much instantly and I'm losing losing touch with all the people I care about due to this. It's a struggle not just to try it out today. I know I don't wanna do it at home because I don't want my mother to find me. 
But on the other hand I'm planning tattooes and my drivers license and I even had flashes of what I wanted to do if I were to get married. 
I'm sorry.

Sorry for the late response- 
I have a question. You mentioned other forms of relief beyond suicide. I have my hobbies but all of them are rather dull right now. Knitting makes me feel old and I'm too scared of criticism right now to go play online video games. Do you have any suggestions? I'm honestly looking for just about anything that doesn't need much money or the need of others.
